title: Champagne and Bullets belongs on the Mount Rushmore of bad movies
summary: There's something about a movie like The Room, Troll 2, or Fateful Findings that I find irresistible. These sorts of "so bad they're good" films are marvelous curiosities where ambition far outstrips resources, ability, and self-awareness to become something much greater than the sum of their parts.
author: Terrence O’Brien
